entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: label_join expects at least 3 arguments (v, dst, separator[, src…]), got %d
entries.rationale: parser-enforced arity: label_join requires at least the vector, destination label, and separator arguments. Since cerberus issue #2449, lowerLabelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp joins lowerLabelCallOverExpHistogram and lowerLabelJoin as a third caller, but its own labelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp recognizer re-runs the identical `len(call.Args) < 3` check on the same parser Call before ever calling this function, so the claim is unaffected by the new caller. Since cerberus issue #2528, lowerLabelCallOverExpHistogramDroppingShape joins as a fourth caller, and likewise only reaches this function after its own labelCallOverExpHistogramDroppingShape recognizer has re-run the identical arity check, so the claim is unaffected by it either.
